name: Holy Spirit
overview: Scripture reveals the Holy Spirit as the active presence of God from creation onward, moving over the waters at the world's beginning (Genesis 1:2) and striving with humanity despite their sinfulness (Genesis 6:3). The Spirit's involvement in human affairs is evident in empowering individuals like Joseph, in whom Pharaoh recognized the Spirit of God (Genesis 41:38). Far from an impersonal force, the Holy Spirit is integral to God's sovereign work, demonstrating divine initiative in judgment and restoration, and underscoring His role within the Godhead and in the lives of believers.
